statements.t: UTMD’s 3Q 2026 Gross Profit margin (GPM) was lower than in 3Q 2025 because WW trade shipments were lower while the Company retained the same previous labor and overhead staffing that it previously had in order to support the anticipated substantial new growth in biopharma control device manufacturing.
Targeting a high ROE of 20% (before dividends) remains a key financial objective for UTMD management.

The Company intends to utilize cash not needed to support normal operations in one or a combination of the following: 1) in general, to continue to invest at an opportune time in ways that will enhance future profitability; 2) to make additional investments in new technology and/or processes; and/or 3) to acquire a product line or company that will augment revenue and EPS growth and better utilize UTMD’s existing…
If there are no better strategic uses for UTMD’s cash, the Company will continue to return cash to stockholders in the form of dividends and share repurchases when the stock appears undervalued.
